items.q: How quickly will I get my photos?
items.a: Edited photos are delivered within 5 working days. Cinematic video arrives within 15 working days.

items.q: Do I own the copyright to my photos?
items.a: Yes. 100% copyright belongs to you. All photos and videos are fully yours.

items.q: Are your prices inclusive of GST?
items.a: Yes. All prices shown are final. No hidden charges, no surprise 18% add-on.

Start with the pricing builder to build your estimate, then continue with an availability request, or talk on WhatsApp first. We usually confirm availability within 2 hours during working hours (Mon–Sat, 9 AM–8 PM).

A package is a pre-selected starting point in the pricing builder. When you choose one, it loads coverage services — photographers and videographers — for your event. You can then adjust the services and add optional extras like drone or albums before sending your availability request.
